messages:
From: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@bluehorizon.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Unexpected Q1 charges — asking for remediation

Karthik,

We just received our April invoice and saw a substantial one-time charge labeled as 'retrospective usage' for Q1. This is unexpected — the team was on the dedicated plan and we believed overage would be handled under the committed capacity terms. Attached is our internal billing summary (billing_summary_Q1.pdf).

Can you help explain the charge breakdown and whether there's an option for an amnesty or one-off adjustment? We closed a PO in March that we thought would cover the April burst. If needed, happy to jump on a quick call with Carlos and our procurement lead.

Thanks,
Amelia Reed
Head of Platform Operations
BlueHorizon Labs

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@bluehorizon.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 11:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q1 charges — asking for remediation

Hi Amelia — thanks for flagging this and for the attachment. I dug into the activity: BlueHorizon exceeded the provisioned reserved capacity on three burst days in late March while the new ingestion pipeline ramped up. Those bursts triggered per-token billing for the overflow; the invoice line shows a retroactive aggregation for those days.

Immediate next steps I can offer now:
- I'll prepare a line-item reconciliation (usage_breakdown_Q1.csv) and proposed settlement worksheet for review.
- We're prepared to offer a one-time goodwill credit to offset part of the retrospective charge while we finalize capacity smoothing.
- If BlueHorizon is open to expanding committed capacity (which would also lower unit price), I can build that into the settlement so the net impact is minimal and prevents rechannels.

Would you be available for a 30-minute reconciliation call on Tues 4/20? Ben is looped in to advise on commercial offsets.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19 08:30 AM PDT
Subject: Internal — proposed settlement for BlueHorizon (draft attached)

Team — attaching a draft settlement (proposed_settlement.xlsx). Summary of what I recommend:
1) One-time true-up invoice: $38,750 (gross retrospective usage charges)
2) Apply a 25% goodwill credit: -$9,687.50
3) Offer a one-time capacity top-up credit of $5k to be applied to their May invoice if they sign a 12-month capacity increase to add +2 reserved nodes (terms in sheet).
4) Net due: $24,062.50; finance to issue invoice_BH_Q1_trueup.pdf once approved.

Notes / approvals needed:
- Marissa: Need finance confirmation on applying the goodwill credit and the top-up credit mechanics (expense vs. contra-revenue).
- Laura: Please confirm the accounting treatment and whether we can amortize part of the credit over 1 month.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager

Attachments: proposed_settlement.xlsx
